container.name: documents
container.query: SELECT c.id, c.displayName, c.documentFileName, c.description, c.type, c.typeId, c.milestoneId, c.projectPhaseId, c.documentAuthorTypeId, c.milestone, c.projectPhase, c.documentAuthorType, c.legislation, c.datePosted, c.projectId, c.read, c.isPublished, c.documentSource, c.isFeatured, c.documentFileName AS fileNameTokens, c.displayNameSort, c.fileSize, c._ts FROM c WHERE c._ts >= @HighWaterMark ORDER BY c._ts
